trial_court: Family Court-cum-V Additional District Judge at Visakhapatnam (FCOP No. 1550 of 2024)
case_name: Smt Malipeddi Uma vs Sri Malipeddi Srinivasa Rao
facts_of_case: Petitioner filed petition under Section 24 of the C.P.C. seeking withdrawal of FCOP No. 1550 of 2024 and transfer to Vizianagaram.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking withdrawal of a petition to establish sufficient grounds for such withdrawal.
legal_principles.held: Though registered notice sent to the respondent and the same was served on him. none appeared for the respondent. Therefore, 'service held sufficient'.

legal_principles.principle: A party's inability to attend court proceedings due to lack of male assistance does not necessarily warrant a withdrawal of the petition.
legal_principles.held: The material on record prima facie goes to shows that, in view of the matrimonial disputes, the petitioner/wife has been residing separately along with her children in her parents' house at Vizianagaram and she has instituted two (02) cases against the respondent/husband herein i.e., a Criminal Case which was registered as F.I.R.No.76 of 2024, for the offence punishable under Section 85 of B.N.S. and under Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, before the Disha Police Station, Vizianagaram, the same is pending

outcome.final_order: Service held sufficient; petition allowed, FCOP No. 1550 of 2024 withdrawn and transferred to the file of the Judge, Family Court at Vizianagaram.
